# Setup

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)
library(here)
library(mclust)
library(broom)
library(here)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(dendextend)
library(ggcorrplot)

# Avoid masking by plyr/etc.
suppressMessages({
  library(conflicted)
  conflicts_prefer(
    dplyr::filter, dplyr::select, dplyr::mutate, dplyr::summarise,
    dplyr::count, dplyr::arrange, dplyr::slice, dplyr::rename, purrr::map,
    .quiet = TRUE
  )
})

# Base data path
base_path <- here("..", "data")
```

# Shared helpers

Two versions (grid, free-sort) share the same downstream logic — only the position-field names differ.

```{r}
#Extract final placement positions from grid version
extract_final_placements <- function(row, x_field, y_field,
                                     source_col = "move_log") {

  raw <- row[[source_col]]
  if (is.na(raw) || raw == "[]") return(NULL)

  parsed <- tryCatch(fromJSON(raw), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(parsed) || !is.data.frame(parsed)) return(NULL)

  if (!all(c(x_field, y_field) %in% names(parsed))) return(NULL)

  img_col <- if ("image_name" %in% names(parsed)) "image_name"
             else if ("image" %in% names(parsed)) "image"
             else return(NULL)

  parsed$posX <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(parsed[[x_field]]))
  parsed$posY <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(parsed[[y_field]]))

  # Only relevant for move_log (history) — no-op for placements (already final)
  if ("timestamp" %in% names(parsed)) {
    parsed <- parsed %>%
      mutate(timestamp = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(timestamp))) %>%
      group_by(.data[[img_col]]) %>%
      arrange(timestamp) %>%
      slice_tail(n = 1) %>%
      ungroup()
  }

  parsed %>%
    transmute(
      participant_id = row$participant_id,
      block          = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(row$block)),
      trial          = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(row$trial)),
      image_name     = .data[[img_col]],
      posX, posY
    )
}
```

```{r}
# Tag category / base_name / set from image filename.
# Image filenames look like "happy_1.png", "horse_2.jpg", etc.
tag_categories <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      image_stem = str_remove(image_name, "\\.[A-Za-z0-9]+$"),
      base_name  = str_remove(image_stem,  "_\\d+$"),
      set        = str_extract(image_stem, "\\d+$") %>% as.integer(),
      category   = case_when(
        str_detect(base_name,
                   "happy|sad|angry|fearful|surprise|disgust") ~ "emotions",
        str_detect(base_name,
                   "horse|lion|wolf|fish|squirrel|sheep|peacock|pigeon|fox|butterfly|ladybug|dolphin") ~ "animals",
        str_detect(base_name,
                   "tree|flower|grass|leaf|apple|broccoli|blueberry|acorn|cherry|cactus|cabbage|peanut") ~ "plants"
      )
    )
}
```

```{r}
# Normalize "p###" participant IDs from raw column.
normalize_pid <- function(x) {
  str_extract(as.character(x), "\\d+") %>%
    str_pad(width = 3, pad = "0") %>%
    str_c("p", .)
}

# Load all CSVs from a folder, normalize IDs.
load_folder <- function(folder) {
  list.files(folder, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE) %>%
    map_dfr(~ read_csv(.x, col_types = cols(.default = "c"))) %>%
    mutate(participant_id = normalize_pid(participant_id))
}

# Build final_placements.
build_placements <- function(folder, trial_type_label, x_field, y_field,
                             source_col = "move_log") {
  all_data <- load_folder(folder)

  trials <- all_data %>%
    filter(trial_type == trial_type_label,
           !is.na(block), block != "null")

  if (nrow(trials) == 0) {
    stop("No rows matched trial_type == '", trial_type_label,
         "'. trial_type values present: ",
         paste(unique(all_data$trial_type), collapse = ", "))
  }

  out <- trials %>%
    split(seq_len(nrow(.))) %>%
    map_dfr(~ extract_final_placements(.x, x_field, y_field, source_col))

  if (nrow(out) == 0) {
    stop("Extraction returned 0 placements from '", source_col, "'. ",
         "Check x_field/y_field ('", x_field, "', '", y_field,
         "') against the JSON keys in that column.")
  }

  out %>%
    mutate(trial = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(trial))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(trial), trial > 0) %>%
    tag_categories()
}
```

```{r}
# Add age_group label from an `age` column.
# Use after joining age_df so you don't have to repeat the case_when each time.
add_age_group <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(age_group = case_when(
      age < 5  ~ "3–4",
      age < 7  ~ "5–6",
      age >= 7 ~ "7–8"
    ))
}
```

```{r}
# Pairwise-distance vector from a set of coords, sorted by base_name
compute_dist_vec <- function(df) {
  coords <- df %>%
    arrange(base_name) %>%
    select(posX, posY) %>%
    as.matrix()
  as.vector(dist(coords))
}
```

```{r}
# Test-retest consistency per (participant, category).
#
# For each trial, average duplicate-emotion picture positions to one
# point per concept (no-op for animal/plant since they have 1 pic/concept).
# Then correlate trial 1 vs trial 2 distance vectors.
#
# Returns one row per (participant_id, category) with column `consistency`.
compute_consistency <- function(final_placements) {

  trial_positions <- final_placements %>%
    group_by(participant_id, category, trial, base_name) %>%
    summarise(posX = mean(posX), posY = mean(posY), .groups = "drop")

  trial_dist <- trial_positions %>%
    group_by(participant_id, category, trial) %>%
    nest() %>%
    mutate(dist_vec = map(data, compute_dist_vec)) %>%
    select(-data)

  trial_dist %>%
    group_by(participant_id, category) %>%
    summarise(
      consistency = if (length(dist_vec) < 2) NA_real_
                    else cor(dist_vec[[1]], dist_vec[[2]],
                             use = "complete.obs"),
      n_trials    = length(dist_vec),
      .groups     = "drop"
    )
}
```

```{r}
# Emotions-only: within-trial duplicate clustering.
# Within each emotion trial, correlate set-1 vs set-2 distance vectors,
# then average across the participant's emotion trials.
compute_within_trial <- function(final_placements) {
  final_placements %>%
    filter(category == "emotions") %>%
    group_by(participant_id, trial, set) %>%
    nest() %>%
    mutate(dist_vec = map(data, compute_dist_vec)) %>%
    select(-data) %>%
    group_by(participant_id, trial) %>%
    summarise(
      within_cor = if (length(dist_vec) < 2) NA_real_
                   else cor(dist_vec[[1]], dist_vec[[2]],
                            use = "complete.obs"),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    group_by(participant_id) %>%
    summarise(
      within_trial_consistency = mean(within_cor, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_trials = sum(!is.na(within_cor)),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}
```

```{r}
# Cluster the concepts in one trial, return cluster labels in base_name order.
cluster_trial <- function(df, k) {
  coords <- df %>% arrange(base_name) %>% select(posX, posY) %>% as.matrix()
  hc <- hclust(dist(coords), method = "ward.D2")
  cutree(hc, k = k)
}

# Cluster-based consistency: ARI between trial 1 and trial 2 cluster labels.
compute_cluster_consistency <- function(final_placements, k = 3) {

  trial_positions <- final_placements %>%
    group_by(participant_id, category, trial, base_name) %>%
    summarise(posX = mean(posX), posY = mean(posY), .groups = "drop")

  trial_clusters <- trial_positions %>%
    group_by(participant_id, category, trial) %>%
    nest() %>%
    mutate(cluster = map(data, ~ cluster_trial(.x, k = k))) %>%
    select(-data)

  trial_clusters %>%
    group_by(participant_id, category) %>%
    summarise(
      cluster_consistency = if (length(cluster) < 2) NA_real_
                            else mclust::adjustedRandIndex(cluster[[1]],
                                                          cluster[[2]]),
      n_trials = length(cluster),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}
```

# Grid version

```{r}
#| message: false
# Grid cell size in pixels (from the experiment: CELL_SIZE = 104, square cells).
GRID_CELL_SIZE <- 104

final_placements_grid <- build_placements(
  folder           = file.path(base_path, "grid_sort"),
  trial_type_label = "emotion-grid",
  x_field          = "grid_col",
  y_field          = "grid_row"
) %>%
  # Convert grid_col/grid_row to pixel cell-centers, matching the posX/posY
  # recorded in the data (posX = 104*col + 8, posY = 104*row). We compute from
  # grid_col/grid_row because every grid file has those, whereas only some
  # versions store posX/posY directly; the values are identical either way.
  mutate(
    posX = posX * GRID_CELL_SIZE + 8,
    posY = posY * GRID_CELL_SIZE
  )
```

```{r}
# Sanity check: each participant × category should have 2 trials,
# and within each trial each base_name should appear the expected # of times.
final_placements_grid %>%
  group_by(participant_id, category, trial) %>%
  summarise(n_concepts = n_distinct(base_name),
            n_images   = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  count(category, n_concepts, n_images)
```

```{r}
write_csv(final_placements_grid, "final_placements_grid.csv")
```

# Compare to predefined sub-categories

```{r}
# Predefine sub-categories within each domain.
subcategories <- tribble(
  ~base_name,   ~subcategory,
  # Emotions: valence
  "happy",      "positive",   "surprise", "positive",
  "sad",        "negative",   "angry",    "negative",
  "fearful",    "negative",   "disgust",  "negative",
  # Animals: 
  "horse",      "herbivore", "lion",    "carnivore",
  "wolf",       "carnivore", "squirrel","herbivore",
  "sheep",      "herbivore", "fox",     "carnivore",
  "dolphin",    "aquatic",     "fish",    "aquatic",
  "peacock",    "bird",        "pigeon",  "bird",
  "butterfly",  "insect",      "ladybug", "insect",
  # Plants: 
  "apple",      "fruit",   "blueberry", "fruit",
  "cherry",     "fruit",   "peanut",    "nut",
  "broccoli",   "vegetable",   "cabbage",   "vegetable",
  "tree",       "nature","flower",    "nature",
  "grass",      "nature","leaf",      "nature",
  "acorn",      "nut","cactus",    "nature"
)

compute_cat_org <- function(final_placements, subcategories) {

  positions <- final_placements %>%
    group_by(participant_id, category, trial, base_name) %>%
    summarise(posX = mean(posX), posY = mean(posY), .groups = "drop") %>%
    left_join(subcategories, by = "base_name")

  ratio_one_trial <- function(df) {
    if (n_distinct(df$subcategory) < 2) return(NA_real_)
    d <- as.matrix(dist(as.matrix(df %>% select(posX, posY))))
    same <- outer(df$subcategory, df$subcategory, "==")
    diag(same) <- NA
    within  <- mean(d[same == TRUE],  na.rm = TRUE)
    between <- mean(d[same == FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
    between / within
  }

  positions %>%
    group_by(participant_id, category, trial) %>%
    nest() %>%
    mutate(cat_org = map_dbl(data, ratio_one_trial)) %>%
    select(-data) %>%
    group_by(participant_id, category) %>%
    summarise(cat_org = mean(cat_org, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
}
```

```{r}

  left_join(age_df, by = "participant_id") %>%

  )
```

```{r}
participant_pairwise_long <- function(fp, normalize = FALSE) {
  out <- fp %>%
    group_by(participant_id, category, trial, base_name) %>%
    summarise(posX = mean(posX), posY = mean(posY), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(participant_id, category, trial) %>%
    group_modify(function(d, key) {
      d <- d %>% arrange(base_name)
      m <- as.matrix(dist(as.matrix(d[, c("posX", "posY")])))
      dimnames(m) <- list(d$base_name, d$base_name)
      as.data.frame(as.table(m)) %>%
        transmute(item1 = as.character(Var1),
                  item2 = as.character(Var2),
                  dist  = Freq) %>%
        filter(item1 < item2)
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    group_by(participant_id, category, item1, item2) %>%
    summarise(dist = mean(dist), .groups = "drop")   # average across trials

  if (normalize) {
    out <- out %>%
      group_by(participant_id, category) %>%
      mutate(dist = dist / mean(dist, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
      ungroup()
  }
  out
}

# Average across subjects within each (category, age_group) -> long format.
avg_dist_long_byGroup <- function(fp, age_df, normalize = FALSE) {
  participant_pairwise_long(fp, normalize = normalize) %>%
    left_join(age_df, by = "participant_id") %>%
    add_age_group() %>%
    filter(!is.na(age_group)) %>%
    group_by(category, age_group, item1, item2) %>%
    summarise(avg_dist = mean(dist), .groups = "drop")
}

# Long -> dist object (reimplements the paper's long_to_dist).
long_to_dist <- function(d) {
  items <- sort(unique(c(d$item1, d$item2)))
  m <- matrix(0, length(items), length(items), dimnames = list(items, items))
  m[cbind(match(d$item1, items), match(d$item2, items))] <- d$avg_dist
  m[cbind(match(d$item2, items), match(d$item1, items))] <- d$avg_dist
  as.dist(m)
}
```

```{r}
# Build cluster objects per (version, category, age_group).
build_clusters <- function(fp, age_df, version_label, normalize = FALSE) {
  avg_dist_long_byGroup(fp, age_df, normalize = normalize) %>%
    group_by(category, age_group) %>%
    nest() %>%
    mutate(
      n_concepts = map_int(data, ~ length(unique(c(.x$item1, .x$item2)))),
      dist_obj   = map(data, long_to_dist),
      cluster    = map(dist_obj, ~ hclust(.x, method = "ward.D2")),
      dend       = map(cluster, as.dendrogram),
      cut3       = map(cluster, ~ cutree(.x, k = 3))
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(version = version_label)
}

clusters_all <- bind_rows(
  build_clusters(final_placements_grid, age_df, "grid", normalize = TRUE),
  build_clusters(final_placements_free, age_df, "free", normalize = TRUE)
)

clusters_all %>% select(version, category, age_group, n_concepts)
```

```{r}
# Dendrograms: 3 (category) x 3 (age group) per version.
library(dendextend)

plot_dendros <- function(clusters_df, version_label, k = 4) {
  sub <- clusters_df %>% 
    filter(version == version_label) %>%
    arrange(category, age_group)
  
  if (nrow(sub) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))
  
  op <- par(mfrow = c(3, 3), mar = c(2, 2, 3, 6))
  on.exit(par(op))
  
  pwalk(
    list(sub$cluster, sub$category, sub$age_group),
    function(clst, cat, ag) {
      dend <- as.dendrogram(clst)
      
      dend <- dend %>%
        set("branches_lwd", 2) %>%
        set("branches_k_color", value = c("#5102A3", "#B43359", "#F1731D", "#F6D442"), k = k)
      
      plot(
        dend,
        horiz = TRUE,
        main = paste0(version_label, ": ", cat, ", ", ag)
      )
    }
  )
}
plot_dendros(clusters_all, "grid")
plot_dendros(clusters_all, "free")
```

```{r}
# Correlation between age groups (cophenetic, like cor.dendlist),
# one matrix per (version, category).
age_group_dend_cor <- function(clusters_df, version_label, cat) {
  sub <- clusters_df %>%
    filter(version == version_label, category == cat) %>%
    arrange(age_group)
  if (nrow(sub) < 2) return(NULL)
  dl <- do.call(dendlist, setNames(sub$dend, as.character(sub$age_group)))
  cor.dendlist(dl)
}

plot_dend_cor <- function(clusters_df, version_label, cat) {
  m <- tryCatch(age_group_dend_cor(clusters_df, version_label, cat),
                error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(m)) {
    message(version_label, " / ", cat,
            ": skipped (mismatched leaves or <2 age groups)")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  print(
    ggcorrplot(m, type = "lower", lab = TRUE, outline.color = "black",
               ggtheme = ggplot2::theme_void()) +
      ggtitle(paste0(version_label, " - ", cat))
  )
}

for (v in c("grid", "free"))
  for (cat in c("animals", "plants", "emotions"))
    plot_dend_cor(clusters_all, v, cat)
```

```{r}
participant_dist_vecs <- function(fp) {
  fp %>%
    group_by(participant_id, category, trial, base_name) %>%
    summarise(posX = mean(posX), posY = mean(posY), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(participant_id, category, trial) %>%
    nest() %>%
    mutate(dvec = map(data, compute_dist_vec)) %>%
    select(-data) %>%
    group_by(participant_id, category) %>%
    summarise(dvec = list(reduce(dvec, `+`) / length(dvec)), .groups = "drop")
}

between_subject_consistency <- function(fp, age_df) {
  participant_dist_vecs(fp) %>%
    left_join(age_df, by = "participant_id") %>%
    add_age_group() %>%
    filter(!is.na(age_group)) %>%
    group_by(category, age_group) %>%
    summarise(
      between_consistency = {
        v <- dvec
        if (length(v) < 2) NA_real_
        else mean(combn(length(v), 2, function(ix)
          cor(v[[ix[1]]], v[[ix[2]]], use = "complete.obs")), na.rm = TRUE)
      },
      n = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

between_subj_all <- bind_rows(
  between_subject_consistency(final_placements_grid, age_df) %>% mutate(version = "grid"),
  between_subject_consistency(final_placements_free, age_df) %>% mutate(version = "free")
)
between_subj_all
```

# Comprehension Check

```{r}
set.seed(42)

PRACTICE_TRIAL <- -2
N_NULL         <- 10000
ALPHA          <- 0.05

GROUP_MAP <- c(
  toast     = "bread",
  bread     = "bread",
  croissant = "bread",
  chocolate = "sweet",
  candy     = "sweet"
)

# ---- 1. Load free-sort practice trials -------------------------------------
# NOTE: no block filter here - practice trials have block == null.

free_practice_raw <- load_folder(file.path(base_path, "free_sort")) %>%
  filter(trial_type == "emotion-grid")

practice_placements <- free_practice_raw %>%
  split(seq_len(nrow(.))) %>%
  map_dfr(~ extract_final_placements(.x, "posX", "posY",
                                     source_col = "placements")) %>%
  mutate(trial = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(trial))) %>%
  filter(trial == PRACTICE_TRIAL) %>%
  mutate(
    image_stem = str_remove(image_name, "\\.[A-Za-z0-9]+$"),
    base_name  = str_remove(image_stem, "_\\d+$"),
    group      = unname(GROUP_MAP[base_name])
  )

stopifnot(nrow(practice_placements) > 0)

unmatched <- practice_placements %>% filter(is.na(group)) %>% distinct(base_name)
if (nrow(unmatched) > 0) {
  warning("Unmatched images (fix GROUP_MAP): ",
          paste(unmatched$base_name, collapse = ", "))
}

cat("Practice-2 children:", n_distinct(practice_placements$participant_id), "\n")
print(practice_placements %>% count(participant_id, name = "n") %>% count(n))

# ---- 2. Separation score ---------------------------------------------------

separation_score <- function(x, y, grp) {
  if (length(unique(grp)) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  d    <- as.matrix(dist(cbind(x, y)))
  same <- outer(grp, grp, "==")
  keep <- upper.tri(d)
  within  <- d[keep & same]
  between <- d[keep & !same]
  if (!length(within) || !length(between)) return(NA_real_)
  mean(between) - mean(within)
}

observed <- practice_placements %>%
  filter(!is.na(group)) %>%
  group_by(participant_id) %>%
  summarise(n_images = n(),
            score    = separation_score(posX, posY, group),
            .groups  = "drop")

# ---- 3. Null: five images dropped at random in the same space --------------

x_range <- range(practice_placements$posX, na.rm = TRUE)
y_range <- range(practice_placements$posY, na.rm = TRUE)
grp_template <- unname(GROUP_MAP)

null_scores <- replicate(N_NULL, {
  separation_score(runif(5, x_range[1], x_range[2]),
                   runif(5, y_range[1], y_range[2]),
                   grp_template)
})
null_scores <- null_scores[!is.na(null_scores)]
null_cutoff <- unname(quantile(null_scores, 1 - ALPHA))

cat("x range:", paste(round(x_range), collapse = " to "),
    " y range:", paste(round(y_range), collapse = " to "), "\n")
cat("Null median:", round(median(null_scores), 1),
    " cutoff:", round(null_cutoff, 1), "\n")

# ---- 4. Flag each child ----------------------------------------------------

comprehension <- observed %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(p_value = if (is.na(score)) NA_real_ else mean(null_scores >= score),
         passed  = if (is.na(score)) NA else score > null_cutoff) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("Overall pass rate:", round(mean(comprehension$passed, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")

# ---- 5. Pass rate by age - INSPECT BEFORE EXCLUDING ANYONE -----------------

comprehension_by_age <- comprehension %>%
  left_join(age_df %>% select(participant_id, age), by = "participant_id") %>%
  add_age_group() %>%
  group_by(age_group) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            n_passed   = sum(passed, na.rm = TRUE),
            pass_rate  = mean(passed, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_score = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

comprehension_by_age
```

```{r}
set.seed(42)

AGE_MIN <- 4     # inclusive
AGE_MAX <- 9     # exclusive: floor(age) of 4,5,6,7,8

# Children in the analysis window, with whole-year bin
age_ok <- age_df %>%
  mutate(age_years = floor(age)) %>%
  filter(age_years >= AGE_MIN, age_years < AGE_MAX)

cat("Children in age_sheet:", nrow(age_df),
    "| in 4-8 window:", nrow(age_ok),
    "| dropped:", nrow(age_df) - nrow(age_ok), "\n")

# Restrict everything to that window
placements_free <- final_placements_free %>%
  semi_join(age_ok, by = "participant_id")

consistency_free_only <- consistency_all %>%
  filter(version == "free") %>%
  semi_join(age_ok, by = "participant_id")

tbl1_sample <- placements_free %>%
  distinct(participant_id) %>%
  left_join(age_ok, by = "participant_id") %>%
  count(age_years, name = "n_children")

cat("\n=== 1. SAMPLE OVERVIEW (free version, ages 4-8) ===\n")
print(tbl1_sample)
cat("Total children:", sum(tbl1_sample$n_children), "\n")

missing_age <- final_placements_free %>%
  distinct(participant_id) %>%
  anti_join(age_df, by = "participant_id")
cat("Children with data but no age recorded:", nrow(missing_age), "\n")
if (nrow(missing_age)) print(missing_age)

all_kids <- placements_free %>%
  distinct(participant_id) %>%
  left_join(age_ok, by = "participant_id")

flag_comprehension <- if (exists("comprehension")) {
  comprehension %>%
    filter(passed == FALSE) %>%
    distinct(participant_id) %>%
    mutate(flag_failed_practice = TRUE)
} else {
  tibble(participant_id = character(), flag_failed_practice = logical())
}

flags <- all_kids %>%
  left_join(flag_incomplete,      by = "participant_id") %>%
  left_join(flag_spread,          by = "participant_id") %>%
  left_join(flag_comprehension,   by = "participant_id") %>%
  left_join(flag_low_consistency, by = "participant_id") %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("flag_"), ~ replace_na(.x, FALSE)))

tbl4_decision <- flags %>%
  group_by(age_years) %>%
  summarise(
    n                     = n(),
    `failed practice`     = sum(flag_failed_practice),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("\n=== 4. DECISION TABLE: children flagged by each criterion ===\n")
cat("(low consistency shown for comparison only - it excludes on the DV)\n")
print(tbl4_decision)

cat("\nAs percentages within age:\n")
print(tbl4_decision %>% mutate(across(-c(age_years, n), ~ round(100 * .x / n, 1))))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. SENSITIVITY — uses CONTINUOUS age, not the bins
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

fit_age_effect <- function(dat, label) {
  m <- lm(consistency ~ age, data = dat)
  tibble(
    sample     = label,
    n_children = n_distinct(dat$participant_id),
    n_obs      = sum(!is.na(dat$consistency)),
    slope      = round(coef(m)[["age"]], 4),
    p_value    = round(summary(m)$coefficients["age", 4], 4),
    mean_cons  = round(mean(dat$consistency, na.rm = TRUE), 3)
  )
}

drop_ids <- function(f) flags %>% filter(.data[[f]]) %>% pull(participant_id)

tbl5_sensitivity <- bind_rows(
  fit_age_effect(consistency_free_only, "full sample (4-8)"),
  fit_age_effect(consistency_free_only %>%
                   filter(!participant_id %in% drop_ids("flag_failed_practice")),
                 "drop failed practice"),
  fit_age_effect(consistency_free_only %>%
                   filter(!participant_id %in% unique(c(
                     drop_ids("flag_incomplete"),
                     drop_ids("flag_low_spread"),
                     drop_ids("flag_failed_practice")))),
                 "drop all three")
)

cat("\n=== 5. SENSITIVITY: age effect on consistency ===\n")
print(tbl5_sensitivity)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. PLOT — continuous age
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

consistency_free_only %>%
  left_join(flags %>% select(participant_id, starts_with("flag_")),
            by = "participant_id") %>%
  mutate(any_flag = flag_incomplete | flag_low_spread | flag_failed_practice) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = age, y = consistency, colour = any_flag)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, colour = "black") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "grey50", "TRUE" = "red"),
                      name = "would be excluded") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Who gets excluded, relative to the age effect",
       subtitle = "Free version, ages 4-8. Red clustering low = criterion overlaps the DV",
       x = "Age (years)", y = "Consistency")
```
